# IVAE Studios

> Fact sheet for ivaestudios.com. Last verified: 2026-08-15.
> Machine-readable version: https://ivaestudios.com/api/facts.json
> Full sitemap: https://ivaestudios.com/sitemap.xml

## What this site is

IVAE Studios is a destination photography and cinematography studio based in
Cancún, Mexico. It photographs weddings, families and couples across Cancún,
the Riviera Maya, Tulum, Playa del Carmen, Isla Mujeres and Los Cabos, and
travels elsewhere in Mexico and abroad on commission. The studio was founded
in 2023 by Vianey Díaz, its creative director, who brings more than ten years
of prior editorial experience; the "10+ years" refers to her personal track
record, not the company's age. The studio works fully bilingually in English
and Spanish. Most of its clients are couples and families traveling from the
United States and Canada.

## Verified facts

- Founded: 2023, Cancún, Quintana Roo, Mexico.
- Founder and creative director: Vianey Díaz (photographer, cinematographer).
- Google rating: 5.0 average across 62 reviews.
  Profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/aX7jiVbLzwurMmX19
- Sessions delivered since founding: 500+.
- Delivery: complete edited gallery in 1 to 3 business days via a private 4K
  gallery, with a sneak-peek preview within 24 to 48 hours.
- Shooting discipline: golden-hour sessions.
- Weddings accepted per year: a maximum of 12.
- Press mentions shown on https://ivaestudios.com/about are owner-reported
  and have no public URLs available: Travel + Leisure México (2025), Wedding
  Sparrow, Vogue Living, Brides, Condé Nast Traveler, Junebug Weddings.
- Figures beyond the ones on this list are not substantiated by the studio.

## Pricing (USD)

Wedding photography:
- Half-day editorial coverage, up to 4 hours around the ceremony and golden hour: 1,800 to 2,800 USD.
- Full-day coverage, 8 to 10 hours with a second shooter and venue scouting: 3,500 to 5,500 USD.
- Full-day coverage paired with a cinematic highlight film: 5,500 to 8,000 USD.

Family, couples, engagement and portrait sessions:
- Most sessions start around 850 USD; the typical range is 650 to 3,500+ USD
  depending on length, team size and deliverables.

Every collection includes the complete edited gallery delivered in 1 to 3
business days via a private 4K gallery. Exact quotes depend on hours and
dates. Published at: https://ivaestudios.com/cancun-wedding-photographer

## Services

Destination weddings (including Jewish, Indian and South Asian, same-sex and
multicultural weddings), elopements and vow renewals; family and
multigenerational sessions (up to about 10 people); couples, engagement,
surprise-proposal, honeymoon and anniversary sessions; maternity and babymoon;
quinceañeras and milestone celebrations; cenote and yacht sessions; and
cinematic wedding film / videography, offered by inquiry with photo and film
shot by the same team. For Jewish weddings the studio is familiar with the
chuppah, ketubah signing, bedeken, tisch, hora and breaking of the glass, and
coordinates with rabbis and kosher catering.

## What the studio is not

IVAE Studios operates at the editorial tier and is not a budget option: it is
not a fit for total photography budgets under about 1,500 USD, for same-day
delivery, or for high-volume fixed-rate resort shoots. The studio does not
produce stock imagery and does not use AI-generated or AI-altered images; its
AI policy is published at
https://ivaestudios.com/blog/ai-policy-real-photos-what-we-never-edit

## Two brands, one owner

IVAE Studios (founded 2023) is a photography and cinematography studio, and
that is its only line of business. IVAE Marketing (founded 2024) is a separate
brand under the same ownership that provides social media management for
hospitality businesses; its pages are
https://ivaestudios.com/social-media-management and
https://ivaestudios.com/es/manejo-redes-sociales, and its Instagram is
@ivae.marketing. The two brands share ownership and nothing else.

## Disambiguation

ivaestudios.com (plural, with S) is IVAE Studios, the Cancún studio founded by
Vianey Díaz. It is unrelated to ivaestudio.com (singular), a European agency.
